name: Predictive Input Buffer
description: Trajectory-based press and wave-release input buffer with a landing buffer for cube.

preset.name: Buffer preset
preset.description: Buffer window size. Press F6 in a level to cycle Light, Medium, Heavy, Max, Off.

custom-all-frames.name: Custom window: all modes (frames @ 60fps)
custom-all-frames.description: Only used when the preset is Custom.

custom-wave-frames.name: Custom window: wave (frames @ 60fps)
custom-wave-frames.description: Only used when the preset is Custom.

landing-buffer.name: Cube landing buffer
landing-buffer.description: Fire a mid-air press at touchdown if it lands inside the window.

sim-budget-ms.name: Prediction time budget (ms)
sim-budget-ms.description: If predicting a press takes longer than this, the raw input is used instead. 0 = unlimited.

assume-tap.name: Predict a tap, not a hold
assume-tap.description: Assume you release shortly after a cube takes off, instead of holding the button forever. Holding forever makes the predictor think you bunny-hop into the next obstacle, which hides valid rescues.

ignore-unmodeled.name: Predict through pads/orbs (experimental)
ignore-unmodeled.description: By default the prediction stops when it touches a pad, orb, dual/mirror/teleport portal, etc. and your raw input is used. Turn this on to ignore those objects and keep predicting. Can mispredict jumps that rely on them.

debug.name: Debug logging
debug.description: Log every buffered/delivered input to the Geode log.
